title: Finite polynomial inverse certificates descend along tensor base change to a stage
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $(A_i)_{i\in I}$ a diagram of commutative rings with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], $i_0\in I$, and $B_0$ a commutative $A_{i_0}$-algebra. Fix $n,m\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_m\in B_0[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Regard $A$ and each $A_i$ for $i\geq i_0$ as $A_{i_0}$-algebras via their coprojection and transition. Let $f_{j,A}$ and $f_{j,i}$ be the coefficient images under $b\mapsto1\otimes b$ into $(A\otimes_{A_{i_0}}B_0)[x]$ and $(A_i\otimes_{A_{i_0}}B_0)[x]$. If $f_{j,A}$ admit a polynomial inverse certificate [def-weil-pbc-etale-polynomial-certificate], then $f_{j,i}$ admit one at some $i\geq i_0$. No finite-presentation hypothesis on $B_0$ is required.

proof.text: Expand first memberships as sums e_klj f_j and second memberships as sums h_jab f_a f_b. Finite ideal generation gives these expressions, since products f_a f_b generate J². There are finitely many coefficient polynomials.
Identify each polynomial base change with A_i tensor P₀ (or A tensor P₀), where P₀=B₀[x]. Transitions are coefficientwise ring maps and hence commute with partial derivatives.

Lift finite lists c,e,h by part (1) of elementwise tensor-colimit descent. Directedness moves them to one stage above i₀. The expanded equation differences vanish at the colimit, so part (2) and directedness kill all differences at one later stage. These equations give both certificate families there.
